#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""CLI with pyproject.toml configuration support using cyclopts."""

import cyclopts

# Create app with TOML config file support
# Defaults are loaded from [tool.mycli] in pyproject.toml
# Command-line arguments override config file values
app = cyclopts.App(
    config_paths=["pyproject.toml"],
    config_key="tool.mycli"
)

@app.default
def main(
    name: str = "World",
    greeting: str = "Hello",
    count: int = 1,
    verbose: bool = False,
):
    """Greet someone with configurable options.
    
    Defaults can be set in pyproject.toml under [tool.mycli]:
    
    [tool.mycli]
    name = "Alice"
    greeting = "Hi"
    count = 3
    verbose = true
    
    Command-line arguments override these defaults:
    
    $ python cli.py --name Bob --greeting Howdy
    """
    for _ in range(count):
        message = f"{greeting}, {name}!"
        print(message)
    
    if verbose:
        print("Verbose mode enabled")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    app()
